rows.grounds: numeral denoting the eight supernatural powers
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam; attainment of powers identified as the root Kaula

items.question: How is the attainment of the eight siddhis identified within the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight siddhis are enumerated as a specific attainment.
The attainment of siddhis is equated with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed directly to the goddess.
items.inference: Therefore, within this teaching, attaining the eight siddhis constitutes the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific list of the eight siddhis is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
